label: Coverage, from same-supporter presence (inference)
rule: Direct: the supporter found elsewhere is itself present and supporting at w
meaning: Coverage follows from the existing open premise that whatever supports a being necessary from w, at a world where it exists, also exists at w and supports it at w. Coverage is strictly weaker on its concrete domain: in the rooted-pair control coverage holds while same-supporter presence fails. Registered as a strength order (presence strengthens coverage); its existing consumer records why it needs the stronger premise. Conditional consequence only.
